blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court has issued subpoenas to four witnesses for Vice President Sara Duterte, who are scheduled to appear on Nov. 19 and 20 —three to testify on matters involving Cale88 Foods Corp. and one to discuss the country’s anti-money laundering law. The House prosecution announced this in a statement on Wednesday, noting that P818 million in alleged unexplained wealth of the vice president remained unanswered in the face of financial evidence presented by the prosecution against the vice president and her husband, lawyer Manases “Mans” Carpio.
